name: Cessna 172 Skyhawk
summary: Four-seat high-wing single and the most-produced aircraft in history; the default US flight-school and rental airplane.

wings: High wing braced by a single lift strut per side
Constant-chord inboard section with tapered outer panels
engines: Single flat-four in a slim, compact cowling
fuselage: Four-seat cabin with one door per side and rear side windows
Fixed tricycle gear with spring-steel mains, often with wheel fairings
Wraparound rear window on post-1963 models
tail: Swept fin with long dorsal fillet (straight fin on 1956–59 models)

tellTales: Strut-braced high wing over a four-seat cabin on fixed tricycle gear
Slim nose with a narrow cowl and two-blade prop
Swept fin with a long dorsal fillet

confusedWith.howToTell: The 172 has a slimmer nose, smaller cowl and usually a two-blade prop; the 182 has a deeper, blunter cowling, larger spinner and often a three-blade prop.
The 172 is larger with a four-seat cabin and longer wing; the 150/152 is a stubby two-seater.
The 172 is a strut-braced high-wing; the PA-28 is a low-wing with no struts.
